BL-1207 — isAbandonedAgentLock's malformed-pid table files a well-formed padded pid as invalid, so its verdict is decided by whether the host happens to be running that pid - red on every systemd host, green elsewhere for the wrong reason
What it solves: Source: hardender note handoff 00_20260827T202743Z_000908_from_hardender_to_specifier_coordinator, verbatim: "isAbandonedAgentLock test assumes PID42 never alive; false here (journald)." Sent to specifier + coordinator at priority 00.
Specifier verification at mint, independently of the note: read …
Approval context: Two calls to say the word on.
(1) Severity medium, not high. Medium because it is test-only, one file, no live swarm behaviour degraded, one sitting to fix. The argument for high, which I considered and did not take: it is a hard unallowlisted red on the primary dev host that blocks the hardener's …
BL-1207 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1207" (or "reject BL-1207 <reason>") to act.
